source.datasetLabel: UCSD Steam Australian users/items + 2018 Steam game metadata
source.scope: Historical Australian Steam users/items; not representative of present population
source.meanShareDenominator: All distinct normalized behavior users, zero for absent tags; balanced weighting

player.displayName: 演示玩家 · 合成游玩记录

warnings: 演示时长为人为构造，不代表任何真实玩家。游戏标签来自 Steam 商店公开页面。

method.referenceUnknownTagWeight: idf=1 when tag is absent from historical catalog; retain direct evidence

referenceProvenance.datasetLabel: UCSD Steam Australian users/items + 2018 Steam game metadata
referenceProvenance.scope: Historical Australian Steam users/items; not representative of present population
referenceProvenance.meanShareDenominator: All distinct normalized behavior users, zero for absent tags; balanced weighting

method.coverageMeaning: coverage 为有标签游戏占完整游戏库比例；playtimeCoverage 为有标签游戏时长占完整游戏库时长比例。playedGames 仅指已取得详情的已游玩游戏。
method.tagWeight: sampleCatalogIdf = 1 + ln((catalogTaggedGames + 1) / (tagDocumentFrequency + 1)); normalize within each game
method.scoreMeaning: 相对偏好强度：最高标签为 100；不是喜欢概率。share 为直接贡献占比。
method.unknownMeaning: 缺失或零时长为未知，不判定为不喜欢。
method.association: 样本游戏标签共现，正关联过滤；不代表同义关系，不传播用户偏好。
method.catalogSource: UCSD Steam historical metadata + local Steam metadata
